title: New Latvian Saeima starts to shape up with nearly all votes counted
summary_full: At 7:30 AM on Sunday, October 4, the vast majority of polling stations had counted all their votes, and according to these data, six candidate lists have an opportunity to make it into the 15th Saeima.
